notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 1.03
notes.content:
Greetings Colonists!
We are excited to announce the first update since the full launch of ExoColony: Planet Survival.

This patch includes a few important fixes and minor improvements based on logs collected during the first week of release.


Fixes
Bug with colonists removal after death fixed.

Toxic gas terraformation calculation updated to match common room toxic levels.

Potential problem with multiple placement of terraforming buildings fixed.

Various other small fixes.


Improvements
Added localization to 4 more languages.

Surface plants are now growing when conditions are favourable.

Minor rebalancing of terraformation progress.



Congratulations to the first colonists on successfully terraforming the planet!



Thank you for your continued support!
– The Simplemole team

notes.title: 🚀 ExoColony 1.0 – OUT NOW!
notes.content:
ExoColony Has Left Early Access!

Greeting colonists, the wait is over – ExoColony: Planet Survival v1.0 is LIVE right now.  
Update Steam, dive in, and start shaping your new homeworld.

🌎 What 1.0 Adds
•  Maps improved, difficulty rebalanced, two more maps added.
•  Leaderboard and calculation of score  improved, now you can see player's rank, map name and difficulty together with best score of each player.
•  Colonists can be now manually assigned to a specific home or workplace.
•  Colonists working in Drilling Hub and Builders Hub are now faster.
•  Fonts and font sizes in non-english languages improved and fixed.
•  Added several new Game Events to notify players for various events.
•  A lot of balancing improved.

🛠️ Roadmap
•  June: continuous bugfixing, balancing updates and small enhancements.
•  July: small feature updates.

Thank you for your continued support!
— The Simplemole Team

notes.title: Full Release – ExoColony 1.0 lands on 2 June!
notes.content:
Greetings Colonists!
We are excited to announce that ExoColony v1.0 releases on Monday, 2 June 2025 at 10 AM PT. 🌎🚀

What to expect in 1.0?
• Two more maps added, maps improved, map difficulty rebalanced.
• Added several new Game Events to notify players for various events.
• Windows in user interface can be now moved to any position.
• Resource Overview window improved.
• Colonists can't be unfreezed if there is no accomodation for them.
• Upgrading of buildings improved.
• And a couple more surprises that will be uncovered on the release day...

Thank you for your continued support!
– The Simplemole team

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.92
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!
We are excited to announce the release of next update of ExoColony: Planet Survival!
This update brings a lot of improvements and fixes. We expect full release of the game in next 2-4 weeks, we will let you know once we fix the date.
Thank you for your continued support!

Rebalancing and Fixes

 Improved and fixed pathfinding
 Fixed hover on buildings that are under construction.
 Deconstruction calculation fixed, deconstruction of storage automatically move items in storage to other storages.

Feature updates

 Colony View informations improved - added avg. life expectancy, avg. child per woman, avg. morale penalty
 Colonists may be now manually assigned to the home/work buildings.
 Production limit are now displayed in resource tooltips.
 Colonists education progression improved.
 Offline buildings are now slightly darker.
 Variability of room backgrounds increased.
 Houses priority can be now managed and gets comfort penalty when out of power.
 Constructions can be now paused and resumed.
 Research and Education rebalanced, items consumption increased.
 Oxygen Generator building added.
 Information about colonists walking speed now visible and explained.
 Buildings can be now restricted for ideal colonists profession only.
 Resource bar now showing the trend (increasing/decreasign) when significant.

Others

 Improved and optimized colonists animations.
 Build notification icons updated.
 Visual information if Oxygen Masks and Exosuites are used added.

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.85
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!
We are excited to announce the release of next update of ExoColony: Planet Survival!
This update brings again quite a lot of new content and moves the game closer to full release, which we expect to be within the next 1–2 months.
Thank you for your continued support!

Tutorial and descriptions

 Building descriptions, research descriptions, game mechanics explanations greatly improved.
 Tutorial heavily updated, extended by 7 new goals.
 Localizations updated and improved.
 Game text notifications and audio notifications improved.
 Added tooltips to factory recipe priorities. Pressure and temperature tooltips improved.
 Navigation menu added to the Help screen.

Feature updates

 Existing maps balance improved.
 Education planning greatly improved, you can now set target education and see progress in Colonists Overview window.
 Overall terraformation score % is now calculated and displayed.
 New Edicts added.
 High pollution now reduce life expectancy.
 Toxic environment now affects fertility.
 Temperature now affects morale.
 You can now research Oxygen Masks and ExoSuite to work in harmfull environments without penalties and not losing health.
 Colonists houses can now be configured to accomodate only colonists with defined professions (after advanced education is researched)
 Teleport building added - colonists can now move across the map faster.
 Steam Leaderboard added - you can now compare your score with other players.

Rebalancing

 Food, Goods and Housing comfort bonuses increased.
 Drills production and building costs rebalanced, drills consumption for harder blocks increased.
 Cost of mid-game and late-game research reduced.
 Costs of terraformation projects slightly reduced.
 Productivity penalty calculations updated (now several tiers when suboptimal).

Others

 Significant performance optimizations.
 Children now occupy house when they are born, new colonists are not born if there is no space in houses.
 Fixed potential problems with game save/load when games before version 0.8 existed.
 Terraformation window merged into Colony Overview window
 AirFilter now requires Gas Cylinder to be build and burns no power when it is idle.
 Colonists leave harmfull environment if health <50.

notes.title: ExoColony Major Update to version 0.80
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!

We are excited to announce the release of Major Update of ExoColony: Planet Survival! 
Please note that this update BREAKS previously SAVED GAMES. 
We have maintained save compatibility since September 2024, but recent changes such as building size adjustments made it no longer feasible. To avoid future disruptions, we’ve bundled all breaking changes into this update and do not plan to break save compatibility again going forward.
Thank you for your continued support!

This update brings a huge amount of new content and moves the game significantly closer to full release, which we expect to be within the next 2–3 months.

Terraformation

 Terraformation hugely improved.
 New terraformation projects added.
 Terraformation window updated.

Temperature management

 Rooms and blocks now has temperature.
 Heat Tunnel building and related research added.
 Power plants can now produce heat instead of power.
 Temperature can be now turned on when map is starting.

Buildings updates

 BioReactor added: late-game building that helps with pollution and oxygen.
 BioWaste plant added: mid-game building that allows production of biowaste from Biopulp.
 Ventilation center now decrease Oxygen filtering capacity gradualy in time.
 Removed Oxygen Generator, player can use airfilter before electrolyzer is researched.

Research updates

 Research tree vastly updated and rebalanced.
 New research categories added.
 About 10 researches removed.
 About 25 new researches added.

Other improvements

 Critical and optimal levels for atmosphere gases updated.
 Details about materials transformations added.
 Existing maps updated and new maps added.
 Colonists consumptions can be now changed on game start.
 Informations about buildings greatly improved.
 Translations improved.


Stay tuned for more changes. Happy colonizing!

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.67
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!

We’re excited to announce the release of our v0.67 Update for ExoColony: Planet Survival! This update includes tweaks, bug fixes, and performance enhancements to improve your gameplay experience.

Bug Fixes
* Low productivity notification fixed (not shown when build was empty).
* Food incubator now can be turned on/off.
* Colonist tooltip fixed.
* Added build time time to missing items.
* Added ability to open Airlock (when it is turned off).
* Calculation of utilization in Food Incubator fixed.
* Utilization calculation added to Moss, Air Filter and Air Purifier.
* Colonist tags are now displayed in colonists overview if some problems exists.

Graphics
* Fixed a bug where the background atmosphere turned black unexpectedly.

Locallization
* Fixed czech language in intro texts.
* Added missing strings in all languages
* Updated names in research and buildings section.

Balancing & New Features
* Initial visibility on maps around ship reduced.
* Speed of unlocking new research has been adjusted to steadily pace.
* Ice Melter research moved to early stage & Ice Melter recipe upgrade has been removed.
* Moss fixed and rebalanced.
* Vent Center updated to start working a bit later. (If other filtering/producing buildings are filtering gases, Vent Center would remain inactive or as support to those buildings. That results longer life of Vent Center).
* Biowaste removed from production limits.
* Ship Liquid Tanker capacity has been reduced from 200 -> 100.
* Added upgrade button to Foundations and Lifts.
* Added info how effective AirFilter is.
* Pollution cycle rebalanced.
* Gas Cylinder is now separate research.
* Water recycling recipes updated.
* Power consumption adjusted for Education Center (4,5 -> 3). 
* Power consumption adjusted for Pollution Recycler (5 -> 2).
* Speed up reaction time on CTRL or SHIFT modifier in production limit window.
* Changes in priority and workers limit can apply to all builds of the same type if CTRL or SHIFT is pressed.

System
* Save data files are now compressed, to save space.

Happy colonizing!

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.65
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!

We’re excited to announce the release of our v0.65 Update for ExoColony: Planet Survival! This update includes tweaks, bug fixes, and performance enhancements to improve your gameplay experience.


Edicts
* Added new edict:
* Stable Population - While active, whenever Colonists die, there will be automatic replenishment with a newborn.
* Updated descriptions to clarify edict functionalities.
                
UI
* Fixed tooltips in the Research window so they now display correctly.

Graphics
* Resolved graphics issues with Advanced Foundations & Advanced Lifts. They should now merge properly and offer speed bonuses.
* Fixed a bug where the background atmosphere turned black unexpectedly.

Bug Fixes
* Advanced Foundations & Advanced Lifts now correctly grant increased speed bonuses.
* Storages can be now turned off. All items are moved to other storages. Same situation happens when the storage is being demolished. So the stored items are not lost!
* Air Filter now filters selected gas into Gas Cylinder if there is one in range.
* Atmosphere & Pressure fixed - There were reports that whatever you do, there is a shortage of nitrogen in the atmosphere. In the end everything was set correctly, but 5x-10x lower than intended. So when the Ship Ventcenter was depleted, there was only an option to merge new rooms to get extra pressure. Now Nitrogen Generator generates more Nitrogen and consumes less Soil. Same rules go for Oxygen Generator, Pollution Recycler, Electrolyzer and Hydrogen Power Generator

Performance
* We made significant optimizations in colonist's pathfinding. So there should be no longer spike lags with higher counts of colonists.


Happy colonizing!

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.63
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!

We have released our v0.63 Major Update for ExoColony: Planet Survival. We are adding more advanced buildings, which are adding more depth to the game. Based on your feedback we also added some QoL improvements.

New Buildings

Base
* Advanced Foundation - Faster horizontal movement speed.
* Advanced Lift - Faster vertical movement speed.
* Advanced Storage (Solid) - Bigger solid storage.

Assembly
* Advanced Drill Assembly - More working places, with new and more advanced Drill recipes.
* Advanced Goods Assembly - More working places, with new and more advanced Goods recipes.

Industry
* Graphene Printer - Allows to process Silicon and Carbon into Graphene.
* Nanobots Foundry - Allows to process Chips and Carbon into Nanobots.
* Alloy Assembly - Allows to process Rare Metal and Rare Mineral into Alloy.
* Earth Transmutator - Allows to transmute Earth various metals and minerals.

Power
* Advanced Battery - Bigger power storage.
* Hydrogen Power Plant - Advanced power generator. Burning Hydrogen into clean power.

Gases
* Advanced Gas Cylinder - Bigger gas storage.
* Electrolyzer - Allows to transform Clean Water into Oxygen and Hydrogen.

Food
* Large Liquid Tank - Bigger liquid storage.

Housing
We made a change for naming housing builds, to be more clear what kind of level you have.
* Advanced Housing - Up for 4 Colonists. Also living here increases productivity by +15%.
* Premium Housing - Up for 5 Colonists. Also living here increases productivity by +25%.

Education
* Advanced Research Center - More working places, with higher productivity.
* Exo Expert Center - Allows your colonists to educate themselves even further. They can now reach Expert education level.

Society
* Fauna Sphere - Morale boosting building for you colonists. Can replenish up to 8 Morale
* Holodeck - Morale boosting building for you colonists. Can replenish up to 10 Morale

Research
* Added over 35 new research options.

Gameplay
* Required research in tutorial goals added.

UI
* You can now see how many research points are available in new research detail.
* Adjustments to research window to reflect all resolutions.
* Building Overview have merged relax and education buildings into work tab.

Settings
* You can now adjust Colonist's aging speed - Normal/-25%/-50%
* Added tooltips to each settings to be more clear what you are setting up.
* Deleting save now requires confirmation.

Graphics
* New Graphics for Moss build.

Bug Fixes
* Fixed various typos in all languages.
* Texts for various events, research, builds, tutorials updated to be more clear.
* Game is now paused when research window is opened.
* Relax buildings no longer reports warning when without colonists.

Happy colonizing!

notes.title: ExoColony Updated to version 0.60
notes.content:
Hello Colonists!

We have released our v0.60 Hotfix for ExoColony: Planet Survival. Based on your feedback here's what we improved:

Bug Fixes
* Fixed an issue when Colonists could fall to another room.
* Fixed an issue with time flow calculations.
* Factory recipe unlocking system updated. Researched recipe is now automatically turned on.
* Oxygen consumption is now correctly used only by colonists. (Dev. note: It was used by industry and power buildings, which led to transformation into pollution and then filtered out back into nitrogen.  That could lead to oxygen levels dropping and room pressure increasing.)


Optimalization
* Performance optimizations when having a lot of active orders, which could lead to significant FPS drop.


UI
* Several icons updated.
* Several triggers and events updated to match the flow.


Localization
* Missing localization strings added.


Happy colonizing!

notes.title: 🚀 ExoColony: Planet Survival - Major Update & Early Access Announcement! 🌍
notes.content:
🌟 New Features & Improvements:

🛠️ New Mechanics – You’ve asked, and we delivered! Experience fresh gameplay with enhanced resource management, dynamic weather systems, and advanced colony-building tools. Every decision matters!

⚖️ Balancing Tweaks – We’ve overhauled the game's balancing to create a more rewarding experience. Whether you’re exploring alien landscapes or managing your colony’s resources, you’ll find the challenge has never been more engaging.

🎨 Updated Graphics – Immerse yourself in the stunning visuals of ExoColony. Our new graphics overhaul brings the planet to life, with more detailed environments, realistic lighting, and breathtaking alien vistas.

🖥️ Better UI – We’ve revamped the user interface for a smoother, more intuitive experience. Managing your colony has never felt this fluid and accessible, allowing you to focus on what matters most—surviving and thriving!

🌱 Terraformation – Introducing the ability to terraform your planet! Shape the environment, unlock new biomes, and transform the alien world into a habitable paradise. Your planet is now yours to design!
⏳ Early Access Release:

Be one of the first to dive into ExoColony: Planet Survival on September 11th, 2024! As a special thank-you, all Early Access players will receive a limited-time discount during launch week. Don’t miss out on your chance to get in early and help shape the future of the game.

🔧 Join the Community:
Your feedback is invaluable, and we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on these new mechanics and updates. Join our community forums and Discord to share your experiences, ideas, and suggestions. Together, we’ll make ExoColony even better!

Prepare for rough landing, and we’ll see you underground and later on the surface! 🚀

Wishlist now and mark your calendars for September 11th, 2024!

notes.title: Research
notes.content:
New Features
  New Tier Cycle - Research:
       
      We understand that colony sim games can be overwhelming with all the things you need to learn to make things work. So we decided after a small tutorial YOU will be in charge of what do you want and need to do next. Running low on storage? No problem just research bigger storage or store into dumpsites, etc.
      Each colonist will produce passively research points. Higher educated colonists will yield higher amounts, but with no education you can expect very little gain. But each researcher in the Research Center will help you with points. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43182479/3cc9935b81132591b413a593c5bc0bd5022b8dae.png

  New Buildings:
             Research Center (Education)
                       Researcher worker slot increases research points gain                  
        
Changes

Farm Incubator now produces more food (Basic Food production per recipe increased from 0.3 to 0.4)
Mining time decreased from base 10s to 8s - (In the early stages of game you spend lot of time digging, so we speed it up a little to keep player more engaged on things that really matters.)

Fixes
Several bug fixes 
Fixed Rare Crashes: Addressed rare instances of crashes and game-breaking bugs reported by the community.

UI
Added Research tab categorized by buildings type
